paper_title: Axion dark matter from topological defects
notes: Pure theoretical/cosmological paper. It numerically computes the relic axion abundance from topological defects (misalignment + global strings + string-wall systems) in the post-inflationary PQ-breaking scenario, and derives cosmological bounds on the axion decay constant and mass by requiring Omega_a h^2 <= Omega_CDM h^2: for N_DW=1, F_a <~ (4.6-7.2)x10^10 GeV and m_a >~ (0.8-1.3)x10^-4 eV (Eqs. 4.5, 4.6); for N_DW>1, constraints in the (F_a, Xi bias-parameter) plane plus a NEDM/CP-violation bound (Eq. 4.9) and predicted mass range m_a ~ O(10^-4 - 10^-2) eV. None of these are new experimental/observational exclusions on the canonical couplings (g_agamma, g_ae, g_an, etc.). The SN1987A bound F_a > 4x10^8 GeV (Eq. 4.10) is quoted from another reference, not derived here. Figs. 7-8 show (F_a, Xi) parameter-space constraints, not a coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve. No new measured limit to report.
